description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for managing note-tag relationships in a Room database. It provides methods for inserting, deleting, copying, and querying note-tag associations, as well as fetching tags for a specific note and notes associated with a particular tag.

classes.name: NoteTagDao
classes.description: Interface providing database access methods for handling note-tag relationships, including insertion, deletion, copying, and various queries.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Insert one or more NoteTagJoin records into the database, ignoring conflicts.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Delete one or more NoteTagJoin records from the database.

methods.name: getByNoteId
methods.description: Retrieve a flow emitting a list of tags associated with a given note ID.

methods.name: copyTags
methods.description: Copy tags from one note to another by inserting noteTag relations for the target note based on the source note's tags.

methods.name: getAllNoteTagRelations
methods.description: Retrieve a flow emitting all note-tag relations.

methods.name: getNotesByTagId
methods.description: Retrieve a flow emitting all notes associated with a specific tag ID.
